findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects, including the vendor roster seed object, are not explicitly protected by a bucket encryption policy using an approved encryption method/key.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, leaving ledger export objects without an explicit encryption-at-rest control.
Versioning and access logging are configured, but no default server-side encryption is configured for model artifact objects.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so stored runbook content lacks an explicit encryption-at-rest safeguard.
